title: aureolaria pectinata subsp. typica
intro: Aureolaria pectinata subsp. typica, commonly known as the bearded pinwheel, is a flowering plant species belonging to the bumblebee balm family (Orobanchaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities that can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Aureolaria pectinata subsp. typica include its ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
